stem: Why are paragraphs 13 through 22 important to the plot of the story?

options.label: F
options.text: They show that both groups are determined to win the sand-sculpture competition.

options.label: G
options.text: They suggest that the girls may cause trouble when the judging begins.

options.label: H
options.text: They show why the boys should not talk with other people in the contest.

options.label: J
